methodology.entry: At the close, require a Positional Trend BUY signal and membership in the most recent Momentum weekly top-15 ranking published on or before that session; execute at the next available open.
methodology.exit: Exit at the next available open on a Positional Trend exit signal or when the held stock is absent from the latest Momentum top-15 ranking.
limitations: NIFTY 500 snapshot membership is used as-of each session, with the loader documented earliest-snapshot fallback.
Momentum weekly rankings are the currently stored published artifacts; historical results inherit their strategy revision and available data lineage.
Stored OHLCV adjustment basis is used; corporate actions are not independently adjusted here.
Daily OHLCV cannot verify opening auction liquidity, upper circuits, or real fill availability.
This is a research simulation, not a broker order or portfolio ledger update.
methodology.lookahead: Momentum membership uses the latest ranking dated no later than the signal session; fills use the following session open.
methodology.portfolio_sizing: Positional Trend risk, order, and volume limits; one position per stock; 50 bps round-trip cost.

invalid_reason: Incorrect exit rule: treated falling out of Momentum top 15 as an exit. The requested exit policy is Positional Trend exit OR Momentum score exit OR Momentum swap.
superseded_by: Corrected hybrid backtest not run: the active workspace database contains no historical market bars, NIFTY 500 universe snapshots, or weekly Momentum rankings; the saved standalone Positional Trend report contains fills/trades only and cannot reconstruct the daily rank/signal series.
